heading.en: Early career and the First World War

body.zh-Hant: 1885年他在斯特拉斯堡的新教文理中學取得畢業資格，1904年調入總參謀部。第一次世界大戰初期，他以中校身分擔任第3軍參謀長，在法國作戰；1915年春改任第11集團軍參謀長，該軍在5月2日至7日打贏戈爾利采—塔爾努夫戰役（突破戰）。1917年12月起他任土耳其野戰軍參謀長，直到1918年11月返回柏林。
body.en: He passed his school-leaving exam at the Protestant gymnasium in Strasbourg in 1885 and was posted to the General Staff in 1904. Early in the First World War, as a lieutenant colonel and chief of staff of the III Army Corps, he fought in France; in spring 1915 he became chief of staff of the 11th Army, which won the Gorlice–Tarnów breakthrough on 2–7 May. From December 1917 he was chief of staff of the Turkish field army, returning to Berlin in November 1918.

citations.quote: an dem er 1885 das Abitur ablegte
bis er 1904 in den Generalstab versetzt wurde
als Oberstleutnant und Chef des Generalstabs des III. Armeekorps
im Frühjahr 1915 wurde er in gleicher Stellung der 11. Armee zugeteilt
am 2.–7.5.1915 die Durchbruchschlacht von GorliceTarnów gewann
im Dez. 1917 Generalstabschef des türk. Feldheeres
Im Nov. 1918 nach Berlin zurückgekehrt

body.zh-Hant: 1918年11月返柏林後，他曾列席凡爾賽和平代表團，後因與團長布羅克多夫—蘭曹伯爵爭執而提前離開。國防軍組建時他接掌軍務局，1920年6月5日接替辭職的賴因哈特出任陸軍統帥部長，被視為國防軍的實際締造者。他於1926年晉升大將，同年10月8日因准許霍亨索倫親王參加國防軍演習而被迫退役。
body.en: After returning to Berlin in November 1918 he joined the German peace delegation at Versailles, which he left early after a dispute with its head, Count Brockdorff-Rantzau. When the Reichswehr was formed he took over the Truppenamt, and on 5 June 1920 he succeeded the resigned General Reinhardt as Chief of the Army Command, becoming the real creator of the Reichswehr. Promoted to Generaloberst in 1926, he had to retire on 8 October 1926 for allowing a Hohenzollern prince to attend a Reichswehr manoeuvre.

nach einer Auseinandersetzung mit dem Leiter der Delegation
Bei der Bildung der Reichswehr übernahm S. das Truppenamt
wurde S. am 5.6.1920 Nachfolger des zurückgetretenen Chefs der Heeresleitung
zum eigentlichen Schöpfer der Reichswehr
zum Generalobersten (1926) aufgestiegen
mußte S. am 8.10.1926 seinen Abschied nehmen
einem Hohenzollernprinzen gestattet hatte, an einem Manöver

body.zh-Hant: 1923年危機中，他曾考慮在總統艾伯特授權下出任帝國政府首腦或取得決定性影響力。1923年11月9日全國宣布軍事緊急狀態，艾伯特依憲法第48條授權他採取一切確保帝國安全的必要措施。他在薩克森未能使該邦置於帝國行政之下，並於1924年3月1日交還全權。
body.en: In the 1923 crisis he considered heading the Reich government or gaining decisive influence over it under a mandate from President Ebert. When a military state of emergency was declared over the whole Reich on 9 November 1923, Ebert charged him under Article 48 with doing whatever was needed to secure the Reich. He failed to place Saxony under a Reich executive and returned his powers on 1 March 1924.

citations.quote: In der Krise des Jahres 1923 erwog S. sogar
an die Spitze der Reichsregierung zu treten
am 9.11.1923 der militärische Ausnahmezustand über das ganze Reich
von Ebert aufgrund des Artikels 48 der Reichsverfassung den Auftrag erhielt
Eine Niederlage erlebte S. auch in Sachsen
gab S. zum 1.3.1924 seine Vollmachten zurück

heading.zh-Hant: 退役後：議員與中國顧問
heading.en: Later years: deputy and adviser in China

body.zh-Hant: 退役後，他在1930至1932年依德意志人民黨身分取得一個帝國議會議席。1933至1935年他擔任蔣介石元帥的顧問，因健康因素中斷，但此後無薪地從柏林繼續此項工作，直到去世。他與納粹主義始終保持距離，卻仍獲得有希特勒參與的國葬。
body.en: In retirement he held a Reichstag seat for the DVP in 1930–32. In 1933–35 he served as adviser to Marshal Chiang Kai-shek, an assignment he had to break off for health reasons but continued from Berlin, unpaid, until his death. Though he had always kept his distance from National Socialism, he was honoured with a state funeral attended by Hitler.

durch ein Staatsbegräbnis unter Beteiligung Hitlers geehrt

heading.zh-Hant: 出身、早年與納粹黨內崛起
heading.en: Origins and rise in the Nazi movement

body.zh-Hant: 1892年5月28日生於梅明根附近的哈旺根，1908年起在蘇黎世受旅館業職業訓練。1911年志願入伍，1914年8月被徵召上西線，1918年升為士官。他1928年加入納粹黨與黨衛隊，1929至1932年領導黨衛隊慕尼黑與上巴伐利亞區，1930年9月選舉後以納粹黨身分進入帝國議會。
body.en: Born on 28 May 1892 at Hawangen near Memmingen, he trained as a hotel clerk in Zurich from 1908. He volunteered for the army in 1911, was drafted in August 1914 and served on the Western Front, rising to non-commissioned officer in 1918. He joined the Nazi Party and the SS in 1928, led the SS district of Munich and Upper Bavaria in 1929–32, and entered the Reichstag for the NSDAP after the September 1930 elections.

citations.quote: Geboren am 28. Mai 1892 in Hawangen bei Memmingen
seit 1908 eine Ausbildung zum Hotelkaufmann in Zürich
1911 trat er als Freiwilliger in das 4. Bayerische Artillerieregiment ein
wurde Dietrich im August 1914 eingezogen
stieg zum etatmäßigen Unteroffizier auf
trat Dietrich 1928 der NSDAP bei und schloss sich der SS an
Von 1929 bis 1932 leitete er den SS-Abschnitt München und Oberbayern
nach den Parlamentswahlen vom September 1930 für die NSDAP in den Reichstag ein

heading.en: Commander of the Leibstandarte SS Adolf Hitler

body.zh-Hant: 1933年3月他奉希特勒之命創建「希特勒警衛旗隊」，此後指揮該部到1943年。1934年6月30日他下令在慕尼黑施塔德爾海姆監獄處決六名衝鋒隊高層。第二次世界大戰中該部擴編為黨衛軍裝甲師，1941年在希臘快速突破，1943年再度攻佔哈爾科夫；1943年7月他卸下該部指揮權。
body.en: In March 1933 he founded the Leibstandarte SS Adolf Hitler on Hitler's orders and commanded it until 1943. On 30 June 1934 he had six senior SA leaders executed at Stadelheim prison in Munich. In the Second World War the unit grew into an SS panzer division, achieved a rapid breakthrough in Greece in 1941 and retook Kharkov in 1943; in July 1943 Dietrich gave up command of it.

citations.quote: im März 1933 auf Befehl Hitlers die „Leibstandarte SS Adolf Hitler“
die Dietrich bis 1943 kommandierte
am 30. Juni 1934 im Münchner Gefängnis Stadelheim sechs hohe SA-Führer
bis 1943 zu einer SS-Panzerdivision erweitert
1941 mit einem schnellen Durchbruch in Griechenland
1943 bei der erneuten Eroberung Charkows

heading.zh-Hant: 軍團與裝甲集團軍指揮
heading.en: Panzer corps and panzer army command

body.zh-Hant: 1943年7月他接掌新編的第1黨衛軍裝甲軍「警衛旗隊」。1944年6月盟軍在諾曼第登陸後，他短暫指揮第5裝甲集團軍，同年10月出任第6黨衛軍裝甲集團軍總司令；1944年8月他被晉升為黨衛軍大將暨武裝黨衛軍裝甲大將。1944年12月阿登攻勢中其部隊的進攻數日即告失敗，1945年3月部隊轉往東線，參與防衛維也納，5月9日他在蒂羅爾的庫夫施泰因被美軍俘虜。
body.en: In July 1943 he took command of the newly raised I SS Panzer Corps "Leibstandarte". After the Allied landing in Normandy in June 1944 he briefly led the 5th Panzer Army there, and in October 1944 became commander-in-chief of the 6th SS Panzer Army; in August 1944 Hitler promoted him to SS-Oberst-Gruppenführer and Panzer-Generaloberst of the Waffen-SS. His army's attack in the Ardennes offensive of December 1944 failed after a few days; in March 1945 it was moved to the Eastern Front and took part in the defence of Vienna, and on 9 May 1945 he was captured by US forces at Kufstein in Tyrol.

führte er dort kurzzeitig die 5. Panzerarmee
im Oktober 1944 Oberbefehlshaber der 6. SS-Panzerarmee
Im August 1944 von Hitler zum SS-Oberst-Gruppenführer
und Panzer-Generaloberst der Waffen-SS befördert
im Dezember 1944 der Angriff seiner Panzerarmee nach wenigen Tagen
Im März 1945 wurde Dietrichs Armee an die Ostfront verlegt
Verteidigung Wiens
Am 9. Mai 1945 geriet Dietrich bei Kufstein (Tirol)
in US-amerikanische Gefangenschaft

body.zh-Hant: 1946年7月他在達豪被美國軍事法庭於馬爾梅迪審判中判處無期徒刑，1955年10月提前假釋。1957年他又因羅姆事件被慕尼黑法院以協助殺人罪判處十八個月徒刑，1959年2月獲准緩刑出獄，此後擔任武裝黨衛軍互助會（HIAG）理事。他於1966年4月22日在路德維希堡去世。
body.en: In July 1946 a US military court at Dachau sentenced him to life imprisonment in the Malmedy trial, and he was paroled early in October 1955. In 1957 a Munich court sentenced him to 18 months for aiding manslaughter in the Röhm affair; released on probation in February 1959, he became a board member of the Waffen-SS veterans' association HIAG. He died in Ludwigsburg on 22 April 1966.

body.zh-Hant: 漢斯—于爾根·馮·阿尼姆1889年4月4日出生，國家圖書館權威檔將他的職業標為大將級的上將（Generaloberst），並稱他是第二次世界大戰期間突尼斯集團軍群的總司令，原屬裝甲兵上將。
body.en: Hans-Jürgen von Arnim was born on 4 April 1889; the national authority file records his occupation as Generaloberst, calls him general of the Panzer troops and commander-in-chief of Army Group Tunis in the Second World War.

citations.quote: Generaloberst

body.zh-Hant: 聯邦檔案館寫道，非洲戰事的最後戰鬥自1942年11月至1943年5月在突尼西亞進行。德方雖新編了非洲集團軍群與隸屬其下的第5裝甲集團軍司令部，仍無法改變敗局；1943年5月13日其餘德意軍隊投降。聯邦檔案館並把阿尼姆列為非洲戰事指揮官之一，保存其遺稿。
body.en: The Federal Archives write that the last fighting of the African campaign took place in Tunisia from November 1942 to May 1943. Although Army Group Africa and the Panzer Army Command 5 subordinate to it were newly raised, this could not change the looming defeat; on 13 May 1943 the remaining German and Italian troops capitulated. The archives list Arnim among the commanders of the African campaign and hold his papers.

body.zh-Hant: 聯邦檔案館藏有阿尼姆的個人遺稿，編號N 61，並已數位化。其任期的確切起迄日、戰後的羈押經過，以及卒年（兩份來源互相矛盾），尚待可抓原文的A／B來源查證。
body.en: The Federal Archives hold Arnim's personal papers under signature N 61 and have digitised them. The exact dates of his commands, the course of his postwar captivity and his year of death, on which the two fetched sources contradict each other, still await verification from fetchable A/B sources.

people.name: Eduard von Böhm-Ermolli
people.nameZh: 爱德华·冯·柏姆-厄尔默利

body.zh-Hant: 1856年2月12日生於安科納。他在聖珀爾滕軍校受教育，並從特蕾西亞軍事學院畢業，1875年成為第4龍騎兵團少尉。1880至1896年他隸屬總參謀部，其後歷任騎兵高級軍官，1911年以騎兵上將身分出任第1軍軍長。
body.en: He was born on 12 February 1856 at Ancona, educated at the St. Pölten cadet institute, and graduated from the Theresian Military Academy; in 1875 he became a lieutenant in Dragoon Regiment 4. He belonged to the General Staff from 1880 to 1896, then went through the career of a senior cavalry officer, and in 1911 became commander of I Corps as General of the Cavalry.

heading.en: Second Army and the Eastern Front, 1914–15

body.zh-Hant: 1914年大戰開始時他率第2軍，起初沿塞爾維亞方向集結，八月調往北方戰場。1914年8月25日他在東加利西亞接掌部隊，在倫貝格南面與西南面作戰；11月8日至23日全軍整體運往普魯士西里西亞。1915年2月中旬他接手喀爾巴阡戰線一段，戈爾利采突破後隨全軍進攻，6月22日進入奪回的倫貝格。
body.en: At the outbreak of war in 1914 he led the 2nd Army, which was first assembling against Serbia but was shifted to the northern theatre in August. On 25 August 1914 he took command of his forces in East Galicia and fought south and southwest of Lemberg; from 8 to 23 November the army was moved as a whole to the Rosenberg–Kreuzburg area to help defend Prussian Silesia. In mid-February 1915 he took over a sector of the Carpathian front, joined the general attack after the Gorlice breakthrough, and entered the recaptured Lemberg on 22 June 1915.

heading.zh-Hant: 集團軍群指揮與元帥晉升
heading.en: Army group command and promotion to field marshal

body.zh-Hant: 1915年9月19日至1916年6月15日，他指揮由第1、第2軍組成的集團軍群，1916年5月7日晉升大將。1916年10月5日起他再度指揮集團軍群，1917年夏擊退克倫斯基攻勢後反攻收復東加利西亞與切爾諾維茨。1918年1月31日他被任命為元帥；3月第2軍參與佔領烏克蘭，這是他最後的作戰任務。1918年5月16日他經皇帝親筆諭令被召離職位，他於1941年12月9日在特羅保去世。
body.en: From 19 September 1915 to 15 June 1916 he led an army group consisting of the 1st and 2nd Armies, and on 7 May 1916 he became Generaloberst. From 5 October 1916 he again commanded an army group, which in summer 1917, after repelling the Kerensky offensive, retook East Galicia and Czernowitz in a counter-attack. He was appointed field marshal on 31 January 1918; the 2nd Army's part in the occupation of Ukraine in March 1918 was his last operational task. By imperial handwritten order he was relieved of his post on 16 May 1918, and he died at Troppau on 9 December 1941.

heading.en: Commands and operations per the Austrian Biographical Lexicon

body.zh-Hant: 奧地利傳記辭典記載，他1905年任少將並指揮克拉科夫騎兵師，1909年任中將並指揮第12步兵師，1911年晉升騎兵上將，任克拉科夫第1軍軍長。1914年他接掌第2軍，參與首次越薩瓦河攻塞爾維亞的攻勢，其後介入倫貝格會戰。1915年6月22日他收復倫貝格，1917年反攻至茲布魯奇河並解放切爾諾維茨，1918年佔領烏克蘭並攻佔敖德薩。
body.en: The Austrian Biographical Lexicon records that in 1905 he became a major-general commanding the cavalry division at Kraków, in 1909 a lieutenant field marshal commanding the 12th Infantry Division, and in 1911 General of Cavalry and commander of I Corps at Kraków. In 1914 he took over the 2nd Army, took part in the first offensive across the Sava against Serbia, and then intervened in the battle of Lemberg. On 22 June 1915 he retook Lemberg; in 1917 a counter-offensive reached the Zbruch and freed Czernowitz, and in 1918 came the occupation of Ukraine and the capture of Odessa.

heading.en: Origins and First World War air service

body.zh-Hant: 1885年2月7日生於符騰堡的路德維希堡，1902年中學畢業後以士官候補生身分進入符騰堡步兵第126團。1914年大戰爆發時他以觀測員身分隨第4野戰飛行隊出征，1915年12月起任該隊隊長，1916年2月因飛機墜毀重傷。直到1918年戰爭結束，他主持科隆飛行觀測員學校及第7集團軍的飛行軍，並參加1918年春季西線諸戰役。
body.en: Born on 7 February 1885 at Ludwigsburg in Württemberg, he began a military career in 1902 after his school-leaving exam, as an officer cadet in Württemberg Infantry Regiment No. 126. At the outbreak of war in 1914 he served as an observer in Field Flying Detachment 4, which he commanded from December 1915 until he was badly injured in an aircraft crash in February 1916. Until the end of the war in 1918 he headed the Cologne observer school and the flying corps of the 7th Army and took part in the Western Front battles of spring 1918.

heading.zh-Hant: 國防軍、空軍擴建與禿鷹軍團
heading.en: Reichswehr, Luftwaffe build-up and the Condor Legion

body.zh-Hant: 戰後他加入國防軍，1926至1933年間晉升為上校。納粹政權利用其組織能力建設新的德國空軍；1935年10月他晉升少將，同時接掌慕尼黑第5航空區的指揮權。1936年11月起他擔任第一任禿鷹軍團指揮官，該軍團在西班牙站在以佛朗哥為首的叛亂方一邊作戰；1937年他被免職並返回德國。
body.en: After the war he joined the Reichswehr, where he was promoted to colonel in 1926–33. The Nazi regime used his organisational skill to build the new Luftwaffe; promoted major general in October 1935, he took over command of Luftkreis V (Munich) at the same time. From November 1936 he was the first commander of the Condor Legion, which fought in Spain on the side of the putschists around Franco; in 1937 he was relieved and returned to Germany.

heading.zh-Hant: 第3航空艦隊與法國、不列顛之戰
heading.en: Luftflotte 3, France and the Battle of Britain

body.zh-Hant: 1938年他晉升上將並出任第3航空艦隊司令。1940年5月起該艦隊參與對法國戰役，與凱塞林指揮的第2航空艦隊密切配合，迅速取得法國上空的制空權。1940年7月他晉升元帥，指揮空軍參與不列顛空戰、隆美爾的北非戰事，並在1943年投入西西里。此後他任西線空軍司令部總司令。
body.en: In 1938 he became a general and head of Luftflotte 3. From May 1940 the fleet was committed to the campaign against France, where, in close cooperation with Albert Kesselring's Luftflotte 2, his air units quickly gained air superiority over France. Promoted field marshal in July 1940, he directed the Luftwaffe in the Battle of Britain, in Rommel's North African campaign and in 1943 on Sicily. He later served as commander-in-chief of Luftwaffenkommando West.

body.zh-Hant: 1944年6月盟軍在諾曼第登陸時，由於盟軍的空中優勢與德國空軍的無力，他在希特勒面前失寵，1944年8月23日被免職，之後在軍事看管下居住於施塔恩貝格湖畔。他在1947至1948年的「國防軍最高統帥部審判」中受審，1948年10月27日與施尼文德海軍上將一同被判無罪。他並非納粹黨或其組織成員，晚年隱居塔伊寧，1953年4月2日逝世。
body.en: During the Allied landings in Normandy in 1944 he fell out of favour with Hitler because of Allied air superiority and the helplessness of the Luftwaffe; he was retired on 23 August 1944 and lived under military guard at Ammerland on Lake Starnberg. Tried in the 1947–48 "OKW Trial", he was acquitted on 27 October 1948 together with Admiral Otto Schniewind. He had belonged neither to the NSDAP nor to any of its organisations, and lived in seclusion at Thaining until his death on 2 April 1953.
